Use nothing but the framebuffer console for everything. Do everything you can in the terminal. If there is something you want to do but have only ever use a GUI for, figure out how to do it in a terminal.

There will be some things that can't be done, but there is also plenty of things that can be done and it's always fascinating to see everything that can be done.
